summary.plain: A neutrino experiment that sent Fermilab's beam 735 kilometres underground to an old iron mine in Minnesota, comparing what arrived to what was measured near the source, from 2005 to 2012.
summary.technical: On-axis NuMI accelerator neutrino oscillation experiment with magnetised steel-scintillator near (0.98 kt, Fermilab) and far (5.4 kt, Soudan) tracking calorimeters, 735.3 km baseline, ~3 GeV peak beam energy. Commissioned on cosmic rays and atmospheric neutrinos from September 2002; took NuMI beam data from 20 May 2005 to 30 April 2012, when it was superseded by MINOS+.
